chapter: Brass bands and Louis in New Orleans
title: Louis in the brass band, Black Benny and waving across the street
summary: Punch says Black Benny looked after Louis, and that Louis passed his place nightly on the way to the 25, waving, before they joined at the next parade.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Did Louis play with you ever?
Yeah, well, he and Black Benny were real good buddies. Black Benny looked after Louis, you see, when he was a kid. You can read that up in the book. No, I didn't.

Black Benny was crazy about me and Louis. Mm-hmm. And, uh, so that's probably the best I can tell you now about brass band. I can't remember it all. Oh, no. But Louis would go to 25 at night, and I would go to Astorias. Oh, yeah. See? He'd have to pass my place every night. He'd stop and stand up. I'd be upstairs. Mm-hmm. Wave, wave, wave, wave, and whatnot. And the next big parade, we'd get together on that.
